data.long_meaning: Arden is an Old English name derived from the word 'earden,' which means 'valley.' It is also believed to be the surname of Arthur, which adds a legendary and noble dimension to the name. In the Middle Ages, Arden was a popular surname for those living near or in a valley. The name Arden carries the meaning “Valley, son of Arthur” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arden usually hope their child will grow to embody valley, son of arthur and live with faith, good character and purpose.
